Results.ReviewText:
In my opinion, the only way to grill food is by using the Weber 22 inch charcoal grill. I have owned and operated many of these types of grills over the past 40 years. Although they could have lasted for many, many years, each of my grills provided me years worth of durability and dependability.  I use my Weber grill daily. It is about the ease of cooking and the wonderful aromas and taste of the foods that mean so much to me. 

I started using my Weber grills in 1981 when I was a young Naval Officer stationed in Hawaii. Grilling captured my enthusiasm  for cooking and enjoying fine foods. Only with a Weber charcoal grill could I find this flavor. My grills never burned my food and the grill itself didn't burn up after only a couple of uses. Weber grills do last a long time especially if kept clean and you manage the charcoal flames. 

I will never use any other brand or type of charcoal grill. It's Weber or nothing at all!
Results.Title: The Only Way to Grill!

Results.ReviewText:
The grill cooks well like any Weber product.  I bought the Premium model thinking that it would stand above the basic model, of which I have had several through the years.  The thermometer on the lid is nice, but not worth the difference in cost above the basic model.  The thing that stands out is the fact that it burns a full load of charcoal EVERY grilling.  The basic model allowed you to close top and bottom vents when you were done cooking and re-use some of the old coals on your next fire.  The Premium model has bottom vents that do't totally close, so ALL charcoal burns with every fire.  This irritates me since I am now on a fixed income.

When I complained to Weber via email and regular mail, I haven't even gotten a "too bad for you" from Weber in almost three months.  They only care about selling grills, not customer satisfaction.  If you like to burn lots of charcoal every day, this is the grill for you. satisfaction
Results.Title: Burns Lots of Charcoal Every Fire

14401001.Name: 22” Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill
14401001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Original Kettle® Premium Charcoal Grill. This grill features a built-in lid thermometer to monitor the temperature inside the grill, and a hinged, plated-steel cooking grate flips up on either side allowing you to easily add more fuel while cooking. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retains heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs. Because some grills don’t just cook food, they make memories.· Porcelain-enameled finish is scratch and rust-resistant· Room to cook for 6-8 people· Hinged, plated-steel cooking grate· Lid thermometer makes it easy to see grill temperature· Adjustable lid and bowl dampers let you control temperature· Lid hook to hang lid on bowl while cooking· 2 tool hooks included on bowl handle· One-Touch™ cleaning system sweeps ash into enclosed catcher· Easy to move on two durable, all-weather wheels· Heat-resistant lid and bowl handles· Bottom, wire storage shelf· Durable fuel grate· 3 aluminum legs are rust-resistant· 10-year limited warranty
